g.text: 01 / WORKLYN
Task-management platform evolving from a modular JavaScript frontend into a complete full-stack application.
Planned features include account authentication, task categories, nested subtasks and live dashboard metrics.
JAVASCRIPT · AUTHENTICATION · TASK MANAGEMENT · FULL-STACK
02 / FINORA
Personal finance application for tracking transactions, budgets, savings goals and financial projections.
Being rebuilt with modular JavaScript and a clear interface, with React introduced progressively as the application grows.
HTML · SCSS · JAVASCRIPT · PERSONAL FINANCE
03 / FMSOLUTIONS
Public collection of 100 Frontend Mentor challenges documenting progressive practice in interface development.
Focuses on responsive layouts, accessibility, reusable patterns and clear project-level documentation.
HTML · CSS · JAVASCRIPT · NPM · RESPONSIVE UI
04 / VENDAFLOW
Ecommerce analytics dashboard designed to centralize multichannel sales, starting with Mercado Livre.
Planned metrics cover daily sales, monthly revenue and profit, sales trends and future marketplace integrations.
REACT · BOOTSTRAP · SASS · ECOMMERCE ANALYTICS
05 / CHECKSPEECH AI
Speech-focused product for transcription and AI-assisted voice analysis through external services.
Planned as a SaaS-style experience that can expand from its landing page into practical voice-processing tools.
REACT · VITE · BOOTSTRAP · SASS · SPEECH AI
06 / MAIZZONBELL
Multiproduct online store offering a diverse catalog designed to reach customers across different product categories.
Evolving into a marketplace with scalable product management, streamlined shopping experiences and opportunities for multiple sellers.
MULTIPRODUCT ECOMMERCE · MARKETPLACE · PRODUCT CATALOG · SCALABILITY
07 / MAIZON SECURITY
Defensive security toolkit combining price monitoring, HTTP header analysis and technical domain inventory.
Designed to track authorized assets, identify potential configuration issues and organize technical findings into reports.
PRICE WATCH · HEADER GUARD · DOMAIN INVENTORY · DEFENSIVE SECURITY
08 / KEYSPRINT
Typing practice application focused on improving speed, accuracy and consistency through short training sessions.
Tracks performance and progress to turn keyboard practice into a measurable learning experience.
TYPING PRACTICE · WPM · ACCURACY · PROGRESS TRACKING
09 / TRIVIA FULL STACK
Interactive quiz platform built around knowledge-based challenges and engaging question-and-answer sessions.
Planned features include topic-based quizzes, answer validation, scoring and performance tracking through a responsive interface.
FULL-STACK · QUIZ GAME · SCORING · PROGRESS TRACKING
10 / YAN
Long-term intelligent assistant envisioned for the Compañías Maizon ecosystem.
Future capabilities include workflow automation, system monitoring, alerts and analysis across compatible tools and services.
AI ASSISTANT · AUTOMATION · SYSTEM MONITORING · INTEGRATIONS
